title: Detection of Human Rhinovirus by PCR following Sanger Sequencing
author: Talita B Gagliardi
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.w83fhyn

steps.title: Set up first PCR reaction
steps.instruction: Combine 3 µL of random cDNA with 10 pM of the forward primer mix (B1, B2, B3) and 10 pM of the FR2 reverse primer in the PCR master mix.

steps.title: Run touch-down PCR
steps.instruction: Program the thermocycler with the polymerase‑manufacturer’s recommended cycling parameters, using a touch‑down annealing profile that starts at 68 °C and decreases by 2 °C every 2 cycles until reaching 52 °C.

steps.title: Purify first PCR product
steps.instruction: Purify 5 µL of the first‑PCR amplicon with ExoSAP‑IT Express PCR Cleanup Reagent (Thermo) following the supplier’s protocol.

steps.title: Set up second PCR reaction
steps.instruction: Combine 3 µL of the purified amplicon with 10 pM of the forward primer mix (B1, B2, B3) and 10 pM of the FR2 reverse primer in fresh PCR master mix.

steps.title: Run second PCR with fixed annealing
steps.instruction: Run the thermocycler using the polymerase‑manufacturer’s recommended cycling conditions, keeping the annealing temperature constant at 52 °C.

steps.title: Purify second PCR product
steps.instruction: Purify 10 µL of the second‑PCR amplicon with ExoSAP‑IT according to the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Perform Sanger sequencing
steps.instruction: Submit the purified amplicon for Sanger sequencing using only the FR2 reverse primer.

steps.title: Analyze sequence via BLAST
steps.instruction: Examine the chromatogram, obtain the nucleotide sequence, and query it against a database using BLAST.
